'''June 2001 Columbia tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Columbia, South Carolina on 30 June 2001. [[Paul Myers]] won it. It is known from Paul Myers's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2554">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-01-columbia-south-car-6-30-01-read-thisd2554/ columbia-south-car-6-30-01-read-this], DeckTech (Paul "lbmyers1" Myers, 1 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-01-columbia-south-car-6-30-01-read-thisd2554/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Columbia, South Carolina
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Myers]]
